units.source: "喂" is a special interjection used only when answering or starting a phone call - it isn't used face-to-face.

units.translation: Usar solo 你好 para iniciar una llamada telefónica: primero va 喂, y después puede seguir 你好.

units.context: Scenario: Phone & Communication · Lesson: Making an Appointment by Phone · grammar (已经 + Verb Phrase + 了)
units.source: "已经...了" states that something has already happened or is already true - "已经有人了" means "already has someone (booked)".
units.translation: "已经...了" indica que algo ya sucedió o ya es cierto: "已经有人了" significa "ya hay alguien (reservado)".

units.context: Scenario: Phone & Communication · Lesson: Making an Appointment by Phone · grammar (已经 + Verb Phrase + 了)
units.source: Omitting the final 了 - 已经 alone can still work, but 已经...了 together is the more complete, natural pattern.
units.translation: Omitir el 了 final: 已经 solo aún puede funcionar, pero 已经...了 juntos forman el patrón más completo y natural.

units.context: Scenario: Phone & Communication · Lesson: Making an Appointment by Phone · grammar (您贵姓？)
units.translation: Preguntar el apellido de alguien de manera formal

units.context: Scenario: Phone & Communication · Lesson: Making an Appointment by Phone · grammar (您贵姓？)
units.source: "贵姓" is a formal, polite way to ask for someone's surname - more formal than 你叫什么名字 from an earlier lesson.
units.translation: "贵姓" es una forma formal y cortés de preguntar el apellido de alguien; más formal que 你叫什么名字, visto en una lección anterior.

units.context: Scenario: Phone & Communication · Lesson: Making an Appointment by Phone · grammar (您贵姓？)
units.source: Using 贵姓 in a casual context with a friend - it fits formal/service situations, not casual introductions.
units.translation: Usar 贵姓 en un contexto informal con un amigo: se ajusta a situaciones formales o de servicio, no a presentaciones informales.

units.context: Scenario: Phone & Communication · Lesson: Making an Appointment by Phone · grammar (Verb + 好了)
units.source: Say something is finished and ready
units.translation: Decir que algo está terminado y listo

units.context: Scenario: Phone & Communication · Lesson: Making an Appointment by Phone · grammar (Verb + 好了)
units.source: "好了" after a verb (here 安排, "arrange") signals the action is complete and everything is ready.
units.translation: "好了" después de un verbo (aquí 安排, "organizar") indica que la acción está completa y todo está listo.

units.context: Scenario: Phone & Communication · Lesson: Making an Appointment by Phone · grammar (Verb + 好了)
units.source: Using just 了 without 好 - 好了 specifically conveys "done and in good order", not just "done".
units.translation: Usar solo 了 sin 好: 好了 transmite específicamente "hecho y en orden", no solo "hecho".
